recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source correction is needed for FHIR-15122; future editorial work should preserve the broader custom-agreement semantics and avoid narrowing implicitRules to implementation guides only.
issue_request: FHIR-15122 was a Published FHIR-I STU3 change request, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, asking that Resource.implicitRules be clarified because it appeared to specify only an associated implementation guide. The resolution said it might indicate an IG but could also indicate a business-context agreement, so the description should be clearer.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites SVN revision 13363, which maps to git-svn commit cf3941f15c410a484846cab676357718699775ff. That commit changed the then-authoritative source/resource/resource-spreadsheet.xml Resource.implicitRules definition/comment to add the implementation-guide clarification and explain the special-rules use case. Later source rework carried the wording into source/resource/structuredefinition-Resource.xml.
additional_context: Resource is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini's resource-infrastructure entry. Current source/resource/structuredefinition-Resource.xml defines implicitRules as a reference to rules followed when constructing the resource that must be understood when processing content, and says it is often an implementation guide. Current narrative in source/resource/resource-notes.xml and source/overview-dev.html describes it as a custom agreement, with an implementation guide as an example. FHIR-43016 later added additionalImplicitRules guidance for multiple policies without reversing this clarification.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active source already preserves the FHIR-15122 clarification and is not misleadingly IG-only.

related_jiras.note: Later applied issue on Resource.implicitRules that added additionalImplicitRules extension guidance for multiple policies; it confirms the same element remains active but does not change the FHIR-15122 clarification.
